correctness.rationale: The labelled two-row update is invertible in characteristic two. For odd n, constants split off from the sum-zero subspace, on which S+S^-1 is invertible and the two travelling-wave coordinates conjugate the update to S and S^-1. On constants it is J_2(1). For even n write n=hm with h a power of two and m odd. Nonresonant shift-root components split by the invertible travelling-wave change into one h-block at each reciprocal root. At root 1, S+S^-1 is epsilon^2/(1+epsilon), (T-I)^2=(S+S^-1)T, and ker(T-I) has dimension two; nilpotence index at most h and local dimension 2h force two h-blocks. The elementary divisors descend to the given field. Fixed vectors for S^t are constant on gcd(n,t) coordinate cycles; for odd n the sum-zero condition removes one dimension since cycle lengths are odd. This yields the asserted defect and count; Mobius inversion yields both the primitive populations and doubling relation. For odd n the sum-zero vector e_0+e_1 has exact shift period n for n>=3, so in direct sum with a moving constant-block vector the actual period is 2n. The equal-population remark means Q=2 only, not all finite fields of characteristic two. Independent exhaustive XOR dynamics over Q=4 for n=3,4,5 agreed (e.g. at n=3 the populations at 1,2,3,6 were 4,12,1020,3060); the finite test is supplementary, not the proof.
